monsters.label: Monster
steps: A new mystery monster card is revealed every day.
Type any Yu-Gi-Oh! monster name in the search bar to make a guess.
Read the feedback on each clue to narrow down the mystery monster.
Keep guessing until you find the exact card!

spells.label: Spell
spells.objective: Identify the daily spell card in 6 attempts or less
steps: A new mystery spell card is available every day.
Search for any Yu-Gi-Oh! spell card name to make your guess.
The card image starts completely blurred and becomes clearer with each guess.
Plan your guesses carefully: use elimination and logical deduction!

traps.label: Trap
traps.objective: Discover the daily trap card within 6 attempts
steps: Each day brings a new mystery trap card to identify.
Enter any Yu-Gi-Oh! trap card name to submit your guess.
The image gets less blurry with each attempt: use visual clues!
Think about card relationships and mechanics, and make every guess count.

specialCases.subtitleMonsters: Yu-Gi-Oh! has many special monster types. Here's how they're handled so every comparison stays fair.
specialCases.subtitleCards: Understanding how Release Year comparisons work for all card types.
specialCases.footnote: These conversions ensure that all monsters can be compared fairly, regardless of their type.

xyz.title: XYZ Monsters
xyz.description: XYZ monsters don't have levels but have ranks instead. For comparison purposes, Rank is treated as Level.

link.title: Link Monsters
link.description: Link monsters have no Level/Rank and no DEF. Level is the same as Link Value, and DEF as 0.

unknownStats.title: Unknown ATK/DEF Values
unknownStats.description: Monsters with '?' for ATK or DEF are treated as -1 for comparison purposes.

nullValues.title: Null Values
nullValues.description: Monsters with null or missing Level/Rank/ATK/DEF values are treated as 0 for comparison.
examples: Some special monsters may have missing stats

releaseYear.title: Release Year (TCG)
releaseYear.description: Release Year refers specifically to the TCG (Trading Card Game) release date. Cards that were only released in OCG (Official Card Game) and never made it to TCG will show 'N/A' and are considered to have the lowest possible value for comparison.
examples: OCG-only cards show 'N/A' (treated as lowest value)
TCG cards show their actual release year

about.subtitle: The daily Yu-Gi-Oh! card guessing game
about.welcome: Welcome to YGOdle! Test your knowledge of the Trading Card Game universe by finding a new card every day.
steps: Pick a series and a game mode on the home page
Search for a card and submit your guess
Use the colored clues (type, ATK, level…) to narrow it down
Find the card in as few attempts as possible!
about.seriesText: Play with every card ever printed, or only with the cards that appeared in your favorite anime.

privacy.title: Data Storage & Tracking Policy
privacy.footer: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your data
privacy.intro: This policy explains what technologies we use to store data and track usage on our website. Our website primarily uses browser local storage (not traditional cookies) to store game data on your device, and privacy-focused analytics to understand how players use it. None of the data we store locally contains personally identifiable information.

company.text: Refers to YGOdle ("We", "Us" or "Our" in this Policy)

localStorage.text: Browser storage technology that allows websites to store data locally within a user's browser

analytics.text: Services that collect and analyze data about how users interact with our website

localStorage.name: Local Storage
localStorage.text: We use your browser's local storage to remember your game progress (for each series and mode), your selected series and language, prevent multiple plays per day, and store your game history. This data stays on your device and is not transmitted to our servers.

vercel.text: We use Vercel Analytics to understand how users interact with our website. This service collects anonymous usage data such as page views, user interactions, and performance metrics. Vercel Analytics is privacy-focused and does not use cookies or collect personal information. <link>Learn more</link>

google.name: Google Analytics (Optional)
google.text: When available, we may use Google Analytics to track user engagement, game completion rates, and website performance. You can opt-out by installing the <link>Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on</link>.

localStorage.title: Local Storage
localStorage.text: You can clear your browser's local storage at any time. This resets your game progress.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: Vercel Analytics requires no opt-out. For Google Analytics, use the opt-out add-on or disable JavaScript.

browser.title: Browser Settings
browser.text: Most browsers let you clear stored data, block JavaScript, or use private mode.

privacy.contactText: Any question about this policy? Email us at
